name: XCC_BUDGET_DIST_HEADERS
description: This table strores the budget distribution headers during budget import.

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for budget data stored in budgetary control

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION
columns.description: The budget source system where the budget data is prepared

columns.name: SOURCE_BUDGET
columns.description: The budget for which the budget amounts are prepared

columns.name: DATA_SET
columns.description: Set of records to be imported by the budget import process.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_JOB_CODE
columns.description: Job that created the row.?? Valid values are: BUDGET_IMPORT, MULTIPERIOD_IMPORT, SPREADSHEET_IMPORT, RECALCULATION, and FUNDS_RELEASE.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME_RELEASED
columns.description: This attribute is no longer in use.

columns.name: DATA_PURGED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether one or more lines have been purged for this header.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BUDGET_ENTRY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of budget transaction, such as Initial, Revision, and Transfer.

columns.name: OVERWRITE_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Overwrite mode used by the budget import process. Used in calculating values, such as budget increase and budget decrease.

columns.name: IMPORT_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Program that submits the budget import process. Valid values are PPM, ADFDI, FBDI_SINGLE_PERIOD, FBDI_MULTI_PERIOD, HYPERION, and RECALC.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the row. Possible values are ADJ_IN_PROCESS, ADJ_COMPLETED, and COMPLETED.

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION_TXT
columns.description: Justification or reason for budget revisions.

columns.name: BUDGET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: This attribute is no longer in use.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: structure definition of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CHAR1
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CHAR7

columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CHAR9
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CHAR10
columns.description: Descriptive Flexfield: segment of the user descriptive flexfield.

columns.name: APPROVAL_COMMENTS
columns.description: Approval comments from the approver for the budget entry transaction.

columns.name: APPROVED_DATE
columns.description: Time when the budget entry transaction was approved.

columns.name: APPROVED_BY
columns.description: Person who approved the budget entry transaction.

columns.name: REVISION_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Revision description for the budget entry transaction.

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_URL
columns.description: Attachment for approval of the budget entry transaction at the line level.
